children: Oracle Executive Chairman Larry Ellison has canceled a plan to sell up to 50 million shares of Oracle common stock, or $7.5B worth of stock at the current price, with no shares sold under the trading plan, the company said. Ellison has no other plans to sell his Oracle shares.
The 10b5-1 trading plan was adopted on June 22, 2026, and was scheduled to terminate on Oct. 24, 2026, subject to early termination.
The 10b5-1 trading plan was disclosed in Oracle’s Sept. 11
, just a day after the company reported quarterly results that topped analysts’ expectations, with the stock falling just 1.7% following the results.
The stocks have been down 23% from the start of the year.

Ellison, Oracle’s largest individual shareholder, owns roughly 1.16 billion shares, or about 40% of the company. His canceled plan to sell 50 million shares would have represented only about 4.3% of his holdings.

title: Larry Ellison cancels $7.5B Oracle share sale plan
